Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a task force to make recommendations on resident undergraduate tuition policy.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to resident undergraduate tuition rates; creatinga new section; and providing an expiration date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1)(a) A legislative task force on residentundergraduate tuition is established. The task force shall consist ofthe following members: (i) Two members from each of the two largest caucuses of the houseof representatives appointed by the speaker of the house ofrepresentatives. At least one member from each caucus shall be amember of the house of representatives higher education committee; and (ii) Two members from each of the two largest caucuses of thesenate appointed by the president of the senate. At least one memberfrom each caucus shall be a member of the senate higher educationcommittee. (b) All members must be appointed by June 30, 2014. (c) The task force shall serve without additional compensation, butshall be reimbursed in accordance with RCW 44.04.120 while attendingmeetings of the task force. p. 1 SSB 6043 (d) The task force shall appoint its own chair and vice chair andshall meet at least twice. (2) The task force shall provide recommendations to the governorand relevant committees of the legislature on resident undergraduatetuition policy by December 1, 2014. (3) Staff support for the task force must be jointly provided bythe senate committee services and the house of representatives officeof program research. (4) This section expires December 31, 2014.
